Rocket $A$ has positive velocity $v(t)$ after being launched upward from an initial height of 0 feet at time $t = 0$ seconds. The velocity of the rocket is recorded for selected values of $t$ over the interval $0 <= t <= 80$ seconds, as shown in the table above.

(a) Find the average acceleration of rocket $A$ over the time interval $0 <= t <= 80$ seconds. Indicate units of measure.

(b) Using correct units, explain the meaning of $integral_(10)^(70) v(t) d t$ in terms of the rocket's flight. Use a midpoint Riemann sum with 3 subintervals of equal length to approximate $integral_(10)^(70) v(t) d t$.

(c) Rocket $B$ is launched upward with an acceleration of $a(t)= frac(3,sqrt(t + 1))$ feet per second per second. At time $t = 0$ seconds, the initial height of the rocket is 0 feet, and the initial velocity is 2 feet per second. Which of the two rockets is traveling faster at time $t = 80$ seconds? Explain your answer.
